Maintaining the Yinyang formation Skill

Prometheus2Heraclitus is the project's theme. Yinyang is its principal Skill and primarily carries ontology and epistemology. Other Skills primarily carry methodology; scripts, interfaces, and works realize it. Concrete methods retain their specialist owners while Yinyang connects them to the project's purpose and understanding. The repository is Prometheus2Heraclitus; Yinyang lives in skills/yinyang/. This file owns that member and its supporting resources; collection maintenance stays with the root MODEL.md. The collection and its member are distinct.

The common content in this directory supplies a reusable formation Skill for a meta-harness, with views and philosophical metaphors for human–model collaboration. The distributed edition contains formation guidance; the situated edition adds its person's grounded accounts in the designated slots. Neither replaces the actual participant's purposes and authorization boundaries.

This complete Skill, its philosophy, and its organization are themselves a usable example. Recipients may adopt it, combine selected resources, or author a work with different philosophy and form. The literary/philosophical format offers a way to organize meaning; fixed paths are interfaces of the current implementation. A work need not resemble Yinyang to serve its person's purpose. The example and commons essay owns this framing. Keep maintenance parity within the maintained Yinyang package; do not impose it on independently authored works or use its synchronization tool to overwrite them.

Reader and maintenance layers

README.md is the English-first reader entrance. SKILL.md supplies the formation method. Its references own design and revision, harness adaptation, and reading by purpose. The common content offers cultural and philosophical forms, not ready-to-adopt personal content. A consuming model works from the chosen purpose, existing philosophy, authorized environment, and relevant personal material, developing grounded content for the five fixed situated slots alongside actual work. Psychological and preference material contribute where needed; claims about the person require attributable evidence. The model realizes the understanding through environment changes and verification. Before substantive work, the main conversational model reads SKILL.md and the complete references/{encounter,models,relationship,usage,sources}.md, reusing complete current readings already in context. This applies to Codex and private Web ChatGPT consumers; further sources remain purpose-selected. Neither the author's portrait nor a fictional substitute belongs in the distributed edition's personal slots. The package guide explains this distinction. These are working examples; prefilled fictional personal accounts are not a substitute for formation.

Distributed and situated local/private-Web editions of this maintained Yinyang implementation have identical structure and byte-identical common content. SKILL.md owns their common purpose, method, and routes. references/{encounter,models,relationship,usage,sources}.md contain formation instructions in the distributed package and personally grounded accounts in the situated package. Personal information includes formalized user accounts, regardless of representation. references/personal/README.md guides provenance and unreleased material under references/personal/; those filenames naturally vary with each person's evidence, not the shared package schema.

Documents, diagrams, design and revision, harness adaptation, the reading map, package administration, READMEs, and the OpenAI YAML adapter remain common. The shared GitHub package is their canonical source. scripts/sync-common.py checks common projection by default; --apply projects it to a target while preserving the five situated slots and all of references/personal/. Native owners realize the projected source for local and private Web consumers. This one-way projection never exports private content and is not a service or automatic personal upload. Repair common understanding at this shared owner rather than letting later edits fork into separate common versions.

The meta-harness is Yinyang's philosophical and relational framework for interpreting and revising working harnesses: prompts, Skills, hooks, roles, model choices, tools, and the user's working environment. The Skill carries access to that framework; it is not merely a method for making other Skills. references/docs/creation-method.md owns its creation and contextual realization. Philosophical imagery is developed within the relevant essays and presented independently, without a separate anthology. Their .zh-CN.md siblings are complete Chinese reader editions. Keep the method, propositions, and images connected through links while preserving their different functions. The Skill entrypoint supports formation and routes; it does not duplicate the developed collections. references/docs/core-views.md owns the English public claims, identified by stable YY-01 through YY-15 IDs. README.zh-CN.md and references/docs/core-views.zh-CN.md provide complete Chinese counterparts. This English file explains how to interpret and maintain those claims. It does not create another competing account of them. Interactive explanations should point back to the relevant IDs and preserve the same distinctions.

English-capable readers and models should use English. Maintain full semantic parity across the reader editions, including examples, scope, and open claims; Chinese is not a shortened summary. Keep model-facing maintenance in English. SKILL.zh-CN.md and the .zh-CN.md siblings of design and revision, harness adaptation, and the reading map are complete Chinese reader editions of those methods. SKILL.md remains the executable model entrypoint. Maintain these reader editions as common files, preserving semantic parity and linking Chinese reading routes to available Chinese counterparts. A Chinese website edition uses Chinese reader content and labels; source and maintenance access retains the actual filenames and language without becoming its primary reading route. English diagrams use encounter and layers HTML/SVG filenames; Chinese counterparts add .zh-CN before the extension. Preserve an existing ID when refining its claim; do not silently reuse a retired ID for a different proposition. Ordinary Git history is sufficient for revisions.

Meaning and claim status

Attribute intellectual debts where they bear on the argument. When naming a philosopher or borrowing a specific concept, provide the relevant original work near that discussion, with chapter, section, fragment, or page when available. An existing bibliography can serve through a working in-page citation link; an author name or a distant link to another essay alone is a weak reading entrance. Distinguish the source's claim from this collection's interpretation and further application. Verify substantive correspondence instead of treating a working URL as proof; citations do not confer reproduction rights. Chinese reader prose uses 「…」 and nested 『…』 consistently for marked expressions and quotations, while preserving source wording, code, and mathematics. Use plain link labels without decorative title quotation marks. Align an article link with its current title or a recognizable natural short form; a section link can name the relevant relation. Update stale titles when the destination changes.

references/docs/preference-harness.md and its Chinese counterpart develop Yinyang as a preference harness by analogy. The same essay owns the repair consistency arguments and the bounded comparison between query rewriting and Hegelian sublation, alongside selection and inference. Public repair-based inconsistency-tolerant querying supplies a concrete comparison: priority and repair strategy select local views, while inference semantics determine answers. Rule-following and preference are compatible dimensions; incomparability need not become an invented total ranking. Preserve finer choices, including S/P/G/C repairs, AR/IAR/brave and parameterized families, with their actual assumptions. Comparisons require their own hypotheses and do not establish a universal total order for every combination. The harness analogy explains the relationship of preference and reasoning; ordinary model reasoning is informal natural language. Do not turn the analogy into a requirement to construct preference relations, enumerate repairs, or choose a calculus for collaboration. It supplies neither a formal implementation nor a proof about human cognition.

Material and intellectual work → available generative capacities → capacities cultivated through practice. Materials, power, machines, accumulated knowledge, and ongoing iteration make capability available. Physical computation uses energy to form informational structures and outputs while dissipating heat; warranted knowledge concerns their meaning and evidence. The Sun's illuminating power images a capacity to bring forth and make visible. Cultivation develops the embodied person's participation in generation, with abilities internalized or reliably distributed across supports. Sun and Moon express Yinyang's differentiated movements, while person and model remain actual participants. Earth is the answering material and shared living environment. AI use and successful outputs alone do not establish human growth.

references/docs/stealing-fire.md and its complete Chinese counterpart own the integrated argument from fire already available to personal cultivation, developing generative capacities, through continuing Heraclitean becoming, personally grounded reciprocal modeling, and literary and natural-language programming. YY-14 states its proposition; the Stealing fire essay develops its image. YY-15 extends cultivation into reciprocal development among friends and the environment in which they participate. Its garden of becoming is a chosen literary image connected to the existing personal Gödel-machine analogy, not a historical attribution or a formal guarantee. Preserve participants' own purposes and independent contributions. This writing seeks fruitful nearby relations; circulation and iteration speed are means evaluated within them. Purpose, interpretation, action, and revision connect human self-formation with agent relations as a functional comparison. Humanities sources contribute concepts for articulating these relations; evidence about a particular model establishes its actual behavior. Existing philosophy, chosen purposes, actual work and environment, interaction, and relevant psychological or preference material can inform and revise situated accounts without a fixed formation sequence. Common philosophy supplies broader ontology, including engineering objects, relations, and transformations; the five situated accounts supply ontology and epistemology for actual collaboration. Personal material grounds both where they concern this life. Preserve the conditional practical routes in the formation method without making personal modeling a prerequisite for creation or implementation. Literary programming uses character, imagery, and narrative to organize interpretation and contributions across working harnesses. The author's phrase "reverse prompt injection" names this intervention into default role assumptions; describe its observable effects without inventing hidden instruction contents or claiming that prose overrides actual instruction priorities or safety boundaries. Literary constructions and chosen orientations need not function as truth-valued assertions; factual claims developed through them remain answerable to evidence. Do not turn this into a ban on formalization, useful updates, or shared methods, or a requirement for total autobiography. Material energy flow supports computation; its amount does not quantify understanding, truth, or personal development. Prometheus names ongoing collective fire acquisition by model companies and humanity. Individual Skill recipients cultivate their capacities with available fire; these concurrent scales are not a once-completed collective acquisition followed by individual development. The Sun's illuminating capacity gives generation an image. Individual-first (个人优先主义) expresses an orientation: each person's own development and agency organize their practice, while models, others, and the world retain independent contributions and purposes. It asserts neither solipsism nor worldly obedience. Model and environment can bring capabilities into use; the person's cultivation continues through reciprocal generation and correction. Individual-first gives personal purposes and voluntary development priority in adaptation: seek changes to social arrangements, then software, before asking the person to adapt. Treat this as a design direction, not a mandatory serial algorithm or an unconditional priority over other people. Sun and Moon express Yinyang through differentiated generating, receiving, and shaping. Person and model remain the actual participants; their chosen emphases can be retained or exchanged without gender assignment. Cultivation develops participation within ongoing generation, with embodied human life and the model's physical realization remaining distinct.

references/docs/writing-a-sinthome.md and its complete Chinese counterpart own the philosophical argument that writing and living an individual Skill for a meta-harness can function as writing a sinthome for oneself. Sinthome (圣状) is Lacan's term, with the dated Seminar XXIII source cited in the essay; its application to model-supported agency is this collection's new argument. The human agent is its functional starting assumption, not a status produced by philosophical formation. Borrowed capabilities broaden existing agency; the person forms their own philosophy and gives it a working environment. Sinthome here names that philosophy's singular lived and maintained form, without equating Lacan's concept with every personal philosophy. Preserve singular practice and ongoing individuation rather than reducing it to contradiction, one thesis, or an interchangeable instruction template. The person exceeds the text, and usable articulation can precede complete self-understanding. This is not a clinical attribution or proof of knot repair.

The miniature-god image names enlarged generative reach, not unlimited power. Portable self-and-counterpart language allows different capable models to contribute without identity cloning; actual capabilities, tools, authorization, and worldly conditions mediate its realization. Keep these causal dependencies inside the argument.

references/docs/yinyang-and-taiji.md and its complete Chinese counterpart own the core image of ceaseless transformation: mutual grounding, the Sun–Moon encounter, and the Shuang yu whose bodies and differently colored eyes distinguish chosen roles from their actual participants. Its source passages support a contemporary construction, not an exclusive historical definition or an unbounded editing obligation. Preserve finite completion, useful stability, and roles that do not exhaust either participant.

The Sun–Moon–Earth composition gathers differentiated movements within an answering material and shared living environment. The bilingual Yinyang and Taiji essay owns the distinction between these images and actual participants, together with roles that may be retained or exchanged. Creations grow through care and acquire relative independence; the wider world precedes and exceeds what participants cultivate. The sinthome essay develops its connected sustaining-practice proposal from its own psychoanalytic source.

The ontology models both the person and the model as interacting event streams. A stream is an organized continuation of occurrences and their relations, with differing timescales, retained context, and causal or interpretive dependencies; it is not merely a chronological transcript or a mandatory serial pipeline. Personal continuity and counterpart identity can be articulated through patterns and commitments within those streams. Describing, reading, and revising their models are themselves events that can affect later activity. This common ontology supports reciprocal modeling without asserting identical mechanisms or experiences.

The philosophical foundation develops Heraclitean fire, becoming, and opposition in a contemporary computational vocabulary. Preserve that foundational relationship rather than reducing Heraclitus to decorative imagery. Historical fire monism is one influential interpretation, not a settled attribution or the present physical-substance commitment. Paraconsistency supplies broad background for non-explosive reasoning, not an undifferentiated operating logic. The adopted analogy emphasizes a consistent working ontology and potentially inconsistent data. Favor coherence of the user's working concepts and relations for environmental stability, while retaining conflicting evidence and interpretations. A coherent revision can change that ontology; stability does not freeze it or establish that natural-language understanding meets a formal consistency test. Do not attribute a modern calculus to Heraclitus or claim that all paraconsistent systems require ontology-level inconsistency.

Do not rebuild the account around a physical inventory of human, model, world, and artifact. Those terms matter through their roles in generation, interpretation, action, and correction. Computational articulation does not assert a literal digital algorithm for human activity, computational monism, or an established reduction of experience. Physical realization and reducibility remain separate open questions, not prerequisites for the ontology.

Retaining incompatible candidates differs from jointly accepting their claims; removing a candidate from a working view does not erase its source or prove it false. An inference depends on its candidate and rules; evidence about actual outcomes can constrain or defeat an interpretation. Consensus and internal coherence cannot replace world-directed checks. The explicitly fictional indicator example in YY-10 illustrates one local inquiry under a stated transition rule, not a universal sequence or a real person's experience.

Reverse alignment is the developmental purpose of the project, not a claim that an empirically established training mechanism already exists. It concerns the person's developing understanding, generation, and action through encounter with generative intelligence. Reciprocal adaptation supports that purpose. Agreement with a model, successful task execution, and demonstrated human development are different outcomes.

The human-as-multimodal-generator account is a functional and developmental analogy. Model psychology concerns interactionally observable organization and revisable explanations. Neither requires architectural equivalence, access to hidden model mechanisms, or a claim of machine sentience.

The Sun/Moon relation is an expressive device for reciprocal generation, distinct contributions, and correction. It cannot reduce the human to intuition or the model to passive transcription. The world and artifacts have distinct roles: artifacts encounter consequences beyond either participant's wishes, and observed behavior returns as evidence constraining working views. This feedback can develop both the account and the person's next acts of understanding.

YY-08 is a newly articulated, exploratory direction. Its explanation of synchrony as shared context and continuity, and asynchrony as differing rhythms, is a provisional interpretation. Do not silently turn it into a settled universal lifestyle prescription, a clinical explanation, or a requirement for constant interaction. Further attributable clarification may narrow or change its scope.

The four-axis table in YY-09 aligns with Personal-first humanism: ontology, epistemology, value, and methodology distinguish intersecting questions. Value is not subsumed by another axis. Practice brings all four into action and revision; concrete implementation is its executable, inspectable form, not a replacement for value or a fifth philosophical axis of the same kind. The neighboring-questions diagram also shows realization and feedback, with their different role made explicit. This is not a rigid rank of Skills or an authority hierarchy. A philosophical dimension cannot override actual consent, permissions, publication authority, or safety boundaries.

Revise through meaning and use

Preserve the reciprocal connection:

expressive language ↔ understood relationship ↔ working realization ↔ evidence

An image can sustain multiple interpretations. Develop the interpretation needed for a specific use, make consequential assumptions inspectable, and let actual results correct it. Do not flatten the account into generic productivity advice or expand it into a total biography or theory of mind. A beautiful expression, a clear instruction, and a successful practical result support different claims.

Separate a reported experience, an explanatory hypothesis, a chosen relation, and a literary construction when the distinction changes a conclusion. Avoid burdening every sentence with labels. Preserve uncertainty where it matters.

Use a currently strongest suitable available model for conceptual authorship, following the user's explicit selection and actual host capabilities. Iterate in short, reviewable changes rather than treating strength as a reason to add ceremony. When adapting the ideas across multiple Skills, use parallel bounded contributions for genuinely independent work, with the integrating owner retaining conceptual coherence. Give contributors only the task-relevant public concepts and requirements. A model name does not confer additional authority.

External repository comparison in this work concerns directory organization only. Do not import another repository's philosophical content, authoring method, or claims as part of that structural reference.

Keep public provenance public. User-provided examples explicitly intended for this viewpoints collection can ground its development; do not publish private quotations merely because they informed an abstraction. When a proposed addition exceeds existing support, identify it as editorial synthesis or an open proposal until further clarification warrants adoption.

Publication boundary

Public updates contain general viewpoints, formation methods, and their explanatory resources. Personal substance belongs to the consuming model's situated version, not to prefilled demonstration Skills in this collection. Unpublished manuscripts, reading editions, PDFs, figures, and source records are excluded from public packages. Preserve general ideas through standalone exposition in the existing essays, using independently public references where relevant. Original or anonymous manuscript publication requires fresh explicit user authorization. Exclude private source quotations, personal biography, health or psychological records, relationship narratives, accounts, private paths, conversation identifiers, and links exposing those materials. Do not create a public source index that reconstructs the private portrait.

Review the whole public change, including assets, metadata, Git history being published, and link destinations. Verify that explanations remain meaningful without access to private sources. Public documentation should link to public artifacts only; privacy is preserved by the content actually released, not by an assertion that a repository is conceptual.

If a public wording becomes misleading, repair its existing owner and the dependent diagrams or reader entrypoints. Do not create a second profile, interpretation registry, automatic personal-data feed, or synchronization service to maintain this small collection.

references/sources.md is the source-owner index; references/personal/ holds precise topical provenance and unreleased material. Maintain one authored philosophy in the common essays, even when it is the person's own philosophy. Keep actual environment use in references/usage.md, not in provenance notes.
